items.title: CNA (Singapore): India to test all bottled water brands after Bisleri sample found unsafe
items.content_text: Bisleri, introduced in India in 1965, is a household name in the country where poor water quality often prompts people and tourists to buy packaged water both for homes and at restaurants.
